title: Hong Kong Bookseller Lam Wing-kee, Detained by China, Dies in Taiwan
summary: Lam Wing-kee, a Hong Kong bookseller known for selling material critical of Beijing and who was detained by Chinese authorities in 2015, has died in Taiwan at the age of 70. He had been suffering from lung cancer.
summary_points: Lam Wing-kee, a Hong Kong bookseller, died in Taiwan at age 70.
He was seized by Chinese authorities in 2015.
Lam sold material critical of Beijing.
He had been suffering from lung cancer.
